Data Hub Source Folder

This is the single folder DataVault watches. Every Excel file inside it is inspected — files whose columns match the Data Hub database schema are detected and imported automatically, with no "Import Database" click required. The same folder also feeds Toolkits → JOC Data Processor. The app remembers the folder on this device, so you won't be asked to select it again.

Data Location

The SharePoint/OneDrive folder used by Toolkits → JOC Data Processor to automatically find Master File - JOC Goup and the latest PIERS import records file. This is saved on this device and used every time the app opens. This legacy method is only used as a fallback when no local Data Hub Source Folder (above) is configured.

Microsoft Sign-in (optional)

A browser can't read a private SharePoint folder from just a link — Microsoft requires an actual sign-in. Add your organization's Azure AD app details below to enable real automatic detection. Without this, the app honestly shows "Unable to access" and falls back to local file upload.
